                    PLEADING IN SUPPORT OF REQUEST FOR
               INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION AND FORENSIC AUDIT

TO THE HONORABLE PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION OF TEXAS AND
ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:
Intervenor Christine Thies, appearing pro se, files this pleading in support of Kevin Kennedy and
John Burrows' request for an independent investigation and forensic audit.
I. INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION
The Commission is being asked to rely on forecasts, models, source data, cost assumptions,
planning judgments, and conclusions concerning reliability and consumer benefits. An
independent review would allow a neutral party to determine whether that information is
complete, traceable to its source, reproducible, and supported by the underlying data. This
request does not presume fraud, misconduct, or wrongdoing. Its purpose is to replace speculation
with verification by determining what information was used, what assumptions were made,
whether the calculations can be replicated, and whether material information was omitted or
changed.
II. PUBLIC INTEREST
Landowners and ratepayers will live with the consequences of the Commission's decision.
Independent verification would strengthen the reliability of that decision, protect the integrity of
the process, and promote public confidence regardless of the ultimate outcome.

Respectfully submitted,




Christine Thies
Intervenor, Pro Se
16152 Audrey Ln
Holland, TX 76534
